column1: # The writer's turn (the contract common/contracts/turn.md; C08-TURN-SELF-99). A row — a sequence of events of one side and its actions in order. The form — README.

column4: note
no row — cas ""; confirmed — the turn is its own (steps 2, 3)
holder empty — cas of the version read
another's version unchanged for less than TURN_TERM — taken, the placement pass does not change it
another's version unchanged for TURN_TERM (45 s) by my clock — cas of the version read
the first look — another's turn is fresh (Races: the wait does not depend on the clock of the previous holder)
manifest_rev of the row lower than mine — take, write my own
manifest_rev > mine (as a number: 10 > 9) — do not change, before the term rule (step 1)
the row is unreadable — a refusal of the step (step 1)
conflict of the capture — the turn is not obtained (step 3)
renewal — its own row cas of its own version; conflict — stop the writes (step 4)
a changing write — with the guard of its own version, while its own confirmed request is younger than TURN_TERM; expired — do not write until renewal (step 5)
412 of the guard — stop the current attempt (step 5)
no answer to a write — a barrier: cas of its own version of turn; confirmed — reread intent and the rows, further with the guard of the new version («Barrier»)
no answer to the barrier itself forbids continuing
the barrier did not pass (the version changed) — stop
the end of the pass — holder "" cas of its own version; a conflict is not repeated (step 6)
no row — cas "" with holder = me (P/08.10 N3 step 3)
its own row — cas of the version read, not taken (P/08.10 N3 step 2)
its own row, conflict — waiting
another's and fresh — waiting (step 4)
another's unchanged for TURN_TERM — cas of the version read with holder = me
holder "" (given up on SIGTERM) — cas of the version read
unreadable — waiting, no CAS over an unreadable row (step 1)
each write of the process — with the guard {key: domain/signer-turn, index: my version} (N1.7 guard)
renewal — its own row cas of its own version
SIGTERM at the active one — holder "" cas of its own version (N1.7 release)
an unknown outcome of the take — reread; the row names this instance — step 2 confirms it by cas of the version read (P/08.10 N3, Quint T6)
a write with the guard without an answer — a barrier: reread the turn and decide anew by steps 1–4
an unknown outcome of the take — reread; holder — the mark of this attempt: confirm by cas of the version read (C08-TURN-SELF-99)
an unknown outcome of the take, no row — not obtained in this attempt
an unknown outcome of the take, holder is another's — not obtained
an unknown outcome of the renewal — reread; its own mark — confirm by cas of the version read
an unknown outcome of the take, the row names another instance — not obtained, waiting
